developerNotes.title: Shared Namespace Residue Remains in Manhunt
developerNotes.problem: Production Manhunt code still contains naming inherited from a shared implementation. Current behavior is internally consistent, so no gameplay failure is claimed.
developerNotes.action: Rename shared and domain-specific identifiers so Manhunt ownership is unambiguous.

developerNotes.title: Developer Script-Event Authorization Is Not Centralized
developerNotes.problem: State-mutating developer and admin script events do not consistently pass through one explicit developer authorization owner.
developerNotes.action: Route all developer and admin mutations through one canonical permission service.
